application.gtk_warnings: the four known narrow-editor allocation warnings; none from the wheel

shortcut_portal: not rerun: the change touches neither the shortcuts nor the Hyprland Lua
end_to_end: not rerun; the previous record passed it with the window path

naming.claude_code: terminal title (custom or generated session title); product title 'Claude Code' means none yet
naming.codex: thread_name in $CODEX_HOME/session_index.jsonl for the Herdr-reported session ID; latest entry wins
naming.fallback: Herdr agent name, then pane ID

layout.names: each wholly to its side of a point 24 px beyond the ring on its tick's bearing; wrapped names grow toward the equator; pushed names slide back toward their anchor
layout.geometry_depends_on: count and names only; every name is measured bold with the longest caption after it
layout.captions: inline after the name's last word

look.wash: theme canvas, 60% toward black (white on a light theme), flat, 72% opaque on the overlay, opaque in a window
look.light: trace along the ring at the hand's bearing: near-white 2 px core over a 10 px halo (saturated accent core and faint bloom on a light theme); core reaches 0.55 of tick spacing, at most 16 degrees; low fade at most 0.3 over 12 to 34 degrees; comet tail up to 40 degrees; amber when blocked or missing
look.legend: F12 record · F9 transcript only · Esc cancel
look.cleared_cells: two layers of the wash's colour under every label: the glyphs and pager arrows, spread 1.5 px and softened over 2 px, at 0.9 (0.6 on a light theme); around them a cell about a cell beyond the text sideways and 4 px above and below, feathered over 20 px, at 0.3 (0.05 on a light theme)
look.keys: full ink, two cells before the name; names at 85% ink; the chosen name full ink, no change of weight
look.focus: reverse-video key cell, 2 px underline 3 px below the baseline, tick lifted

cleared_cells_sweep.measure: CIE L* step between the cell and the plain wash over the empty synthetic editor, at 100%, twenty sessions
cleared_cells_sweep.desktop_contrast_beside_a_label: 1 - cell strength of its washed contrast: 70% on a dark theme, 95% on a light one

motion.hand_spring: critically damped, exact step; natural frequency 36 rad/s for a neighbour to 26 rad/s across the dial; never passes its tick
motion.retarget: keeps place and the speed toward the new tick, with the spring retuned for the rest of the way and held firmer if the hand would otherwise pass the new tick; speed away from the new tick is dropped, so the hand never moves further from it
motion.frame_cost_note: three reel runs pooled, machine under load (load average about 8 on 20 threads); 7 of 933 frames over 16.7 ms, scattered

binary_bytes.note: release mluva binary; the baked wheel art was compiled in before
